quote.text: Um período limitado de tempo lhe foi concedido, e se não o aproveitar para limpar as brumas de sua mente, o tempo escorrerá junto com a sua vida, para nunca mais retornar.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the finite nature of time by cultivating mindfulness in your role as a parent, ensuring that every moment with your children is both intentional and enriching.
    • Just as you purify your own mind, strive to create a nurturing environment free from unnecessary distractions so that your children learn the value of clarity and focused presence.
  • Leadership
    • Recognize that effective leadership depends on clear, decisive thought; by clearing the mists of your mind, you can guide your team with vision and purposeful action.
    • Encourage those you lead to honor the value of time, fostering a culture where every moment is used to drive positive change and meaningful progress.
  • Product Management
    • Apply the wisdom that our time is limited by focusing on strategic clarity, making sure that every decision in product development is deliberate and impactful.
    • Aim to declutter not only your mental space but also your workflow, ensuring that the product’s evolution is as streamlined and purposeful as your own journey toward clarity.
